Morality can be subjective, but generally, actions are judged based on their impact on others and adherence to ethical standards. In a corporate setting, especially when someone is in a leadership role, there's an expectation of humility and effective communication. If James is using excessive self-praise, it might come off as arrogant or self-centered.
